messages:
morgan: Quick sync — want to propose a small change to how we sample fallbacks for regional tier routing.
jordan: TL;DR?
morgan: Today we route low-tier traffic to cheaper model variants by default, but telemetry sampling for those fallbacks is sparse across regions. We lose signal for regressions and cost anomalies.
vivian: Oof, yep. We had that blind spot in eu-west last month.
sam: What if we increase sampling only for the first 24h after a policy change or rollout? keep steady-state low sample rate.
cara: That sounds reasonable. How do you mean 'sample' — full payloads or just minimetrics? We need PII-safe flows for EU.
morgan: Minimized telemetry: include request metadata, variant_id, cost_estimate_tokens, latency_us, and an opaque prompt-hash. No raw prompt body for regulated regions.
vivian: Can we encode prompt-hash the same way as existing evals? want consistent de-dup and diffing.
morgan: Yes — reuse the evals hashing util (sha256 -> short hex). We'll add a flag sample_kind: "mini" | "full". Default mini for low tier, full for canary and some manual toggles.
ashley: How will sampling be triggered? Randomized, deterministic by tenant id, or event-driven on error spikes?
sam: Proposal: hybrid. Deterministic sampling for <1% of tenants for long-term trending, plus event-driven burst sampling (5% of affected requests) for N minutes after anomaly detection.
jordan: This helps rootcause while limiting egress/ingest costs. What about regional weighting? e.g., apac gets 2x sample_rate because we have fewer customers there.
morgan: Exactly. Region multipliers. Sample_rate = base_rate * tier_multiplier * region_multiplier * post_rollout_boost
cara: Need API changes in routing service to emit sample_hint in decisions so proxies can attach the right collector tag. Minimal change: add sample_hint in RouteDecision proto.
ashley: Sketch: field sample_hint { kind: string; rate: float; note: string }
ashley: e.g. {kind:"mini", rate:0.01, note:"eu privacy"}
vivian: Will this require a console UI change? Product might want a toggle per-tenant or per-SKU.
morgan: Yes — Console UX: a small sampling section under Routing > Variant fallback with live toggle, per-region overrides, and estimated monthly telemetry cost. Default hidden for self-serve users.
cara: Telemetry pipeline: we should mark mini vs full so ingestion routes differently (mini -> aggregated metrics bucket, full -> raw traces). telemetry-bot, any objections?
telemetry-bot: automated-note: mini-sampled events will be stored for 30d aggregated; full-sampled up to 90d raw with ACL checks.
sam: Also need an alert: if cheap-variant token cost delta > 20% vs host variant AND regression in quality score => auto-escalate sampling to full for 1h.
jordan: Quality score: we'll use evals-run delta plus user-reported labels. Need margin for noisy signals.
morgan: For rollout plan: canary the sampling-control proto in staging, then roll to 10% of routing hosts, monitor telemetry ingestion and console cost estimate. deploy-bot: canary status?
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: routing-service v3.12.4 -> 10% hosts. health checks: OK (3/3).
cara: API backwards compatibility: if older proxies see sample_hint, they should ignore. If new proxies don't see it, routing should default to old behavior (no sampling hint).
ashley: One more: quota accounting. We must ensure telemetry samples do not count against customer token billing. Keep separate internal meter.
morgan: Yep — telemetry tokens will be metered internally and billed to "telemetry-ingest" budget. Console will surface estimated telemetry cost under Billing -> Observability.
vivian: Anything else? I can take the routing proto change + console mockups.
jordan: I'll own the telemetry pipeline tag mapping and cost estimator.
sam: I'll write the rollout playbook and add checks for regional multipliers and privacy gating.
morgan: Great. I'll file a short RFC and include the sample rates table and privacy rules. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
